timing: after outcome-blinded inference timing and before any comparator ground-truth scoring or effect access
reason: The first complete DiceTopK10 five-fold CPU inference case required approximately 10 minutes and the next larger case remained incomplete after a further eight minutes. Extrapolation to both 762-case MAPPING variants exceeded 250 wall-clock hours on the available host. This resource decision was made without ground-truth scoring, performance inspection, threshold tuning, case replacement, or endpoint changes.

analysis_revision.inference: paired center-macro effect estimates and percentile 95% confidence intervals; no multiplicity-adjusted or architecture-superiority test
analysis_revision.qualitative_display: unchanged six performance-blinded cases, with ground-truth, default, and SynthStroke contours
analysis_revision.uncompleted_variant_rule: retain eligibility and feasibility records but report no numerical performance estimate

claim_boundaries: The comparison does not isolate architecture because preprocessing, training data composition, label design, and implementation differ.
The evaluation remains within one public release family and is not prospective or institutionally independent clinical validation.
Null or adverse SynthStroke results remain reportable and cannot trigger model removal or analysis redesign.
